actual_scope: Prove the PR2298 compressed-domain inequalities for every integer b at least 2^524288 and every integer transform exponent L in [ceil(b/2), b], using p=6b, d=floor(p^(1/40)), K=floor(d^(1/500)), and ell=ceil(L/d).
scope_change_reason: Take the section 1 and section 2 parameter-admission part of the explicit independent-review request in PR2298 and Discussion2291. The predecessor tests five compressed sizes. This audit targets the full tail, including floor and ceiling discontinuities.
bottleneck_link: The proposed outer caller must satisfy its geometric, reserve, guard and prime-box inequalities for every sufficiently large input. A finite sampled input does not establish that quantified implication.
stop_rule: Prove all stated tail implications with exact endpoint and induction certificates, or report a precise failing implication. Do not enlarge the scope to the selected callee proofs or a new exponent.
evidence: README.md proves the complete declared parameter tail, with three exact induction certificates. RESULT.json records three compressed fixtures, fifteen length cases and nine rejection controls. The complete callee and multiplication proofs remain outside scope.
